active_experiments.problem: IR-001 passes one offline case, but the local poller and thresholds have no multi-session 09:25/09:35/10:00 shadow evidence and external mapping is still a scenario input.
active_experiments.baseline: IR-001 has 255 no-lookahead snapshots and 15 rule transitions; IR-002 P0 now has immutable observations, monotonic live peaks, explicit freshness/authority, execution-ledger re-entry guards, and checkpoint scheduling, but still no open-session calibration sample.
active_experiments.outcome_metric: Across multiple live shadows, record alert latency, false escalation, missed protection, provider gaps, re-entry blocks, opportunity promotions, and whether substantive state-change notifications would be useful.
active_experiments.smallest_experiment: Use the hardened double-click scheduler for 09:25/09:35/10:00 shadow_only captures without notifications; review one session at a time.
safety_boundaries: No live notification until multi-session state-change evidence passes review
No full-A-share scan; keep 20-30 liquid themes
No scenario external mapping may be relabelled as verified market data
Missing and stale values remain explicit and cannot authorize new exposure
No automatic order placement or holdings overwrite
IR-002 shadow output cannot contain position-action sizing or trade authority
active_experiments.kill_criterion: Stop or recalibrate if alerts arrive after the decision window, false escalation dominates, provider gaps mask state, or opportunity confirmation encourages added risk after the account protection floor breaks.

queued_experiments.problem: The V3.0 ten-run after-close/morning pilot ended before completion when the owner opened V3.1 iteration; its audit capability remains useful but is not the active increment.
queued_experiments.baseline: P0 passed and owner re-review was pending before the intraday pivot.
queued_experiments.outcome_metric: Resume only if intraday evidence shows a specific audit or remembered-plan gap.
queued_experiments.smallest_experiment: Keep the current implementation parked until it is explicitly selected as a V3.1 increment.
safety_boundaries: Do not compete with IR-002 live shadow
queued_experiments.kill_criterion: Do not resume for visual polish alone.

queued_experiments.problem: InsightRadar has a structurally complete Harness but no behavioral baseline proving which controls improve real tasks.
queued_experiments.baseline: Harness structure scores 100/100, but no versioned 20-30-task suite or four-profile comparison exists.
queued_experiments.outcome_metric: Every eligible task reports deterministic success, evidence correctness, false completion, scope drift, privacy, recovery, token or context volume when available, tool calls, elapsed time, and human corrections across declared profiles.
queued_experiments.smallest_experiment: Plan and run a five-task pilot across the four profiles before scaling the accepted schema to 20-30 tasks.
safety_boundaries: Use synthetic or private local tasks only
No holdings, broker data, credentials, or raw private conversations in public artifacts
Deterministic checks are primary; model judging is secondary
No benchmark result grants trade authority or model-superiority claims
queued_experiments.kill_criterion: Stop expansion if the five-task pilot cannot produce reproducible deterministic verdicts or leaks private/secret data.
